label: Custom curve
summary: Replace ordinary price behavior with a fully specified and bounded custom invariant or curve.
requiredFacts: Exact invariant, domain, monotonicity, rounding and boundary behavior
How liquidity, swaps, fees and withdrawals preserve conservation
Partial fills, zero liquidity, extreme prices and failure behavior
requiredTests: Boundary, monotonicity, rounding and overflow properties
Differential checks against an independent reference model
Liquidity add, remove, swap and fee conservation invariants
Adversarial sequences and provider quote mismatch
risks: A mathematical edge case can create free value or trap liquidity
Provider simulation can disagree with nonstandard execution
